svg.title: A via beside a pad: a mask web between them, tented, or no web
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, plan views of a 1.0 by 1.2 mm pad joined by a 0.25 mm trace to a via with a 0.3 mm hole and a 0.6 mm ring. Left, right: the via is 0.55 mm from the pad and each has its own mask opening, leaving a 0.15 mm web of mask between them. Middle, right: the via is tented, covered with mask. Right, wrong: the via is closer and its opening runs into the pad's, so there is no web and solder can run from the pad onto the via and down the hole.

g.text: ✓ Mask web between via and pad
Pad, in its own mask opening
At least 0.1 mm; wider is better
No mask between pad and via
Solder runs onto the via and down the hole
Drawn to scale. Mask openings 0.05 mm larger than the copper.
Thermal vias in a QFN's ground pad stay open on purpose (PCB-DFA-075).
